reason: Mostly taxonomy copy outside workflows; one metric description reworded, with descriptions duplicated across two surfaces kept in sync only by a comment.
New SES tenant-state feature split cleanly into webhook, service, and task modules with tests; hand-rolled SNS verification mirrors Node code. Diff truncated.
Inlines large generated Kea type blocks into workflows logic files and adds deep relative imports like '../../../../../frontend/src/types', bloating already-large files. Diff heavily truncated.
Delay-until-date feature with tests and stories; extracts _validate_delay but further grows the huge hog_flow.py serializer and StepDelay component. Diff truncated.

Skills validation follows the existing connector pattern through the tasks facade, but grows hog_flow.py's serializer and the workflows test imports products.skills models directly.
WorkflowScoutRunViewSet copy-pastes the task viewset's JWT auth and rejection helpers, grows hog_flow.py, and tests import signals scout_harness internals. Diff truncated.
Save-time create-task checks are well tested and reuse validate_connectors via the tasks facade, but add a long method to the already huge hog_flow.py serializer.
Adds search_workflows and a testing helper to the workflows facade, which is the right boundary, but the function returns untyped hogai-shaped dicts.
